svg.title: Tea Blending: Art nouveau apothecary labels
svg.desc: Tea Blending (1D): an apothecary label framed in whiplash curves. Three jars of herbs stand across the top, each label showing its depth, length and binding marks; one spoon of seer's sprig arcs from a jar toward the cup of mint, where two of three spoon slots are already full. The steep ring around the cup is turned to mark 4, and the requirement card below asks for depth 6, length 6 and binding no more than 2.
